purpose: Explicit secondary-ST source amendment; original and pre-ST evidence retained, not clinical acceptance

baselineAmendment.reason: Frozen independent secondary-ST prediction applied to reviewed pre-ST product 3c10eac, retaining its analyzer. Adding a previously absent component changes the clean signal and its filter response; the original strict source-to-source comparison is retained separately, not labelled as passing.

invariants: future clean sources must remain byte-identical to the amended baseline unless a new explicit amendment is reviewed
scope: Regular QRS-coupled secondary ST, including LBBB and ventricular ectopy in the noise benchmark. Torsades and WPW are excluded. Reference branch is not a product release.

baselineHistory.reason: The clean LBBB and PVC teaching sources intentionally changed because secondary T is now derived from the final ventricular activation. Future noise-stress runs compare against this amended source state instead of permanently exempting those presets.

secondarySTMigration.role: Post-hoc engineering source review on exposed data. No prospective or patient validation. All original tolerances preserved against the explicitly declared new source reference.
secondarySTMigration.migrationBounds: No aggregate loss of true QRS or increase of false/missed QRS; no aggregate increase of falsely usable HR/QRS/QT. Every strict stratum deterioration retained in transition report. Unchanged sources must remain exact.
